what_it_is: Optimized Electrotech is an Ahmedabad-based electro-optical and infrared (EO/IR) imaging company building AI-enabled surveillance payloads for defence, space and homeland-security applications, spanning drones, satellites and ground systems. It is part of India's small set of private firms developing native space-grade imaging payloads rather than integrating imported cameras.
india_angle: ISRO transferred its Optical Imaging System technology to Optimized Electrotech in 2023 under an IN-SPACe-facilitated agreement, and the company reports deployment of AI-based surveillance systems with Indian forces and roughly Rs 100 crore of backing. It is a named supplier candidate in India's private EO payload ecosystem.
intelligence_assessment: The ISRO technology-transfer agreement is a verifiable, government-anchored India signal. Revenue-scale, in-orbit performance and defence-order specifics remain thinly evidenced publicly; track subsequent IN-SPACe/ISRO payloads and armed-force procurement notices for confirmation.
